items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do they use the phrase “Freddie Green guitar” with you? [INTERVIEWEE] Sometimes.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, okay, let’s see. First, like Kenny Davern basically likes rhythm guitar for accompaniment. He likes, you know, chunk-chunk-chunk-chunk-chunk behind him, for nice, soft support for what he does. And then occasionally I play some parts with him, like clarinet or something like that. Ruby Braff likes different accompaniment, like some punctuations in the chords, he doesn’t like rhythm all the time, he likes it sometimes. Again he likes, when you do play a part with him he wants to hear it fully. Joe…
Do they use the phrase “Freddie Green guitar” with you?
